title: Oojuro benchmark scorecard
description: One file per suite run (beir | turnloop | memqa | gates). Section order is the comparison order: gates, quality, storage, memory, speed. Every Stat holds the per-run values and their median and spread.

hardware.description: cpu, logical_cpus, mem_total, swap_total, kernel, work_filesystem, rustc, build_profile, load_avg

settings.description: Run conditions. Always: runs, isolation, bench_lock. Suites add k, cache (warm|cold + how), build_time_included, and their own sizes.

references.description: Published numbers for context; never produced by this run.

pass.description: true only if every run passed

info.description: What the arm reported in hello: name, version, commit, durability, protocol, notes

gates.description: byte_exact, byte_exact_after_reopen, get_range_order, as_of_visibility, no_future_leak, freshness, crash_recovery, determinism (by suite)

quality.description: beir: ndcg@10 recall@10 recall@100 mrr@10; turnloop: ndcg@10 ndcg@20 recall@20 hit@20 mrr@10 freshness_self_hit@21; memqa: turn_* and session_recall_*

storage.description: raw_text_bytes, disk_bytes, disk_alloc_bytes, disk_ratio (= disk_bytes / raw_text_bytes)

memory.description: steady_{cgroup,anon,rss}_{bytes,ratio} after load; peak_{cgroup,rss}_{bytes,ratio} at end; ratios divide by raw_text_bytes

speed.description: microseconds inside the arm (*_us) and with protocol round trip (*_roundtrip_*); build_s / prefill_s

breakdown.description: per-slice quality, e.g. memqa question type
